tj_infra: quick ping — I'm about to merge a TF change that adds a new GPU nodepool for inference jobs in us-west-2. need a 1-2 person :eyes: check on instance choices + spot fallback/eviction handling before i ship. PR: https://git.company/repo/pulls/4721

maria_ops: linking the diff now. main concerns: (1) we need a capacity reservation plan for critical models, (2) taints/tolerations + node labels so serving pods land correctly, (3) secret/key access for the node bootstrap to pull model blobs.

alex_g: can you paste the proposed node group snippet? want to confirm mixed instances policy and on-demand baseline.

 tj_infra: here is the relevant snippet from the PR (abbreviated):
 ```hcl
 resource "aws_eks_node_group" "gpu_infer_a100" {
   cluster_name    = var.cluster_name
   node_group_name = "gpu-infer-a100"
   node_role_arn   = aws_iam_role.gpu_node_role.arn
   scaling_config { desired_size = 8; min_size = 2; max_size = 40 }
   capacity_type = "SPOT"
   launch_template { id = aws_launch_template.gpu_lt.id; version = "$Latest" }
   labels = { "workload":"inference", "gpu":"a100" }
   taints = [{ key = "dedicated" , value = "inference", effect = "NO_SCHEDULE" }]
 }
 resource "aws_ec2_capacity_reservation" "gpu_reserve" {
   instance_type = "p4de.24xlarge"
   capacity_reservation_preferences = "open"
   count = 2
   availability_zone = "us-west-2b"
 }
 ```

maria_ops: ok nice. couple notes:
- Capacity reservation on p4de looks fine for burst-critical lanes, but we should avoid putting the node_group capacity_type to SPOT only for the whole group — we want mixed policy so critical pods can land on on-demand/reserved nodes. Suggest: keep separate node group for reserved (capacity_type=ON_DEMAND) with smaller min_size=2 and label reserve=true.
- Add nodeSelector and toleration examples in the DaemonSet/deployment so only inference workloads schedule on reserved nodes.

alex_g: +1. Also we'll need an interruption handler (kube-eviction webhook or SIGTERM script) for graceful draining when spot is reclaimed. Can the launch template include a lifecycle hook?

 tj_infra: yes the launch template already installs the spot-interrupt-handler and sets scale-down-protection=false. I can add a lifecycle hook to drain nodes via ASG notification to an SQS + lambda drain job.

 sophia_research: about secrets: the model bootstrap requires access to a KMS-wrapped token stored in Secrets Manager. we should not bake creds on the AMI. Use IRSA (service account) for the model-downloader daemonset with a constrained role. For node-level image pulls of large model artifacts, prefer a short-lived signed URL from a control-plane job instead of persisting secrets on node.

 tj_infra: agreed — PR updated to: (a) use IRSA for model-downloader SA, (b) remove static keys from userdata, (c) annotate node group with iam.amazonaws.com/role to limit scope.

 maria_ops: can you add a note in the TF changelog about post-deploy validation steps? i.e., verify: node labels present, reserved-nodes tainted, interrupt handler metrics show events within 24h after rollout. Also include rollback steps to scale down the new node group and move critical pods.

 alex_g: quick nit: change instance_type in capacity_reservation to p4d.24xlarge instead of p4de if p4de isn't available in the zone. check AZ SKU availability with infra-tools.

 tj_infra: will run sku-checker. if p4de missing we'll fallback to p4d and shrink the reservation count.

 deploy-bot: Deploy preview for PR #4721 completed in staging — 2/2 checks passed. Logs: https://ci.company/logs/4721

 sophia_research: one more thing — add a Prometheus rule to alert if GPU utilization across pool < 5% for 10m after scale-up, to catch mis-scheduling.

 tj_infra: good call. i'll add that alert and an entry in the runbook. planning to merge in ~3 hours unless anyone objects.

 maria_ops: lgtm from ops side after alex's SKU check. :+1:

 alex_g: will do SKU check in ~30m and post results here.

 tj_infra: thanks all — i'll hold merge until we confirm SKU/az and add the small readme for post-deploy validation. :rocket:
